verdict.rationale: The only documented feature close to this story is the Audio Overview "Debate" format, described as "exploring multiple perspectives". Inline citations and per-source selection let an analyst check answers against individual sources, but they do not themselves surface agreement or conflict. Nothing shows chat answers flagging where sources agree or disagree. Missing for 10: an explicit documented capability to identify agreement or contradiction across sources, the same in chat or text reports (not just an audio format), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can see where sources agree and disagree instead of a single unqualified answer

citations.quote: The Debate for exploring multiple perspectives.
